2105-3499-3603-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-3499-3603-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-3499-3603-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Cloudshift from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Cloudshift from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

803-1168-3000-3510.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-1168-3000-3510.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Arcane Adaptation and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Toggo to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Toggo trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Chatterfang.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

4694-5330-5805-7306.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4694-5330-5805-7306.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Gev.
Resolve the Atog ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

1981-2415-3899-5931.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Funeral Room and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat.

277-851-1308-3129-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

5078-5705-6089.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1}
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Skyswimmer Koi triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Skyswimmer Koi trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat

2187-3617-7370.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Possessed Skaab.
Resolve Time Walk, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Possessed Skaab from exile to the battlefield.
When Possessed Skaab enters, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1417-2946-4871-6797.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
1417-2946-4871-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Bridge from Below trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3923-4050-6259-7639.description:
Cast Mystic Speculation by paying {U} due to Samut.
Namor triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve Mystic Speculation.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Merfolk, adding {U}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 6 or greater
attached to Kami of Whispered Hopes

81-7500.description:
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding at least six mana of any color
Activate Ringing Strike Mastery by paying {5}, untapping Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Repeat.

3605-4812-6553-6797.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it trigger, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Animate Dead to it.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters, it triggers, targeting Dance of the Dead.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Brotherhood Outcast trigger, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it trigger, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters, it triggers, targeting Animate Dead.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Brotherhood Outcast trigger, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-6741-7282.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three multicolored permanents.
2034-6741-7282.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Infinite Guideline Station that is a 1/1 Soldier.
Put the Infinite Guideline Station token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Infinite Guideline Station token enters, it triggers, creating a tapped 2/2 Robot artifact creature token for each multicolored permanent you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three Robots, adding six {C}.
Repeat.

1558-1671-3875-4231-6441.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-1671-3875-4231-6441.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

250-779-1168-1479-6620.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1168-1479-6620.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Toggo and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Sylvan Safekeeper ability
Resolve the Toggo trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

104-2034-3490-6097.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-2034-3490-6097.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

3532-4908-4997-5078.notablePrerequisites: You control another Knight and/or Merfolk.
3532-4908-4997-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Knight and/or Merfolk you control.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

3705-4050-6277-6896.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Squee and the creature token, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

1482-2854-4316-4574.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1482-2854-4316-4574.description:
Cast Jeweled Lotus from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

2639-3254-4050-4770.manaNeeded: {4}{G/W}{B}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2639-3254-4050-4770.description:
Cast Nethroi either from your hand or from the command zone for its mutate cost by paying {4}{G/W}{B}{B}, putting it under a non-Human creature you control.
Nethroi triggers, returning Whitemane Lion and Mitotic Slime from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers, returning Nethroi from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Whitemane Lion and Mitotic Slime, adding {B}{B}.
When Mitotic Slime dies, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Oozes, adding {1}{G/W}.
When the Oozes die, they trigger, creating four 1/1 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Oozes, adding {3}.
Repeat.
2639-3254-4050-4770.notes: During step 2, you can recur other creatures with suitable powers. This will allow you to forego sacrificing that many Oozes in step 8, netting infinite mana and creature tokens. If you have infinite mana and Oozes, you can then forego reanimating Mitotic Slime and reanimate anything else with a suitable power instead.

618-4344-5147.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Lumbering Battlement.
When the Lumbering Battlement token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Lumbering Battlement token.
When the Lumbering Battlement token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

225-539-3478-6628.description:
Activate PuPu UFO by tapping it, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping PuPu UFO as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and is level 2 or higher

1318-2846-5352.easyPrerequisites: You control a mana-producing permanent that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {U}.
1318-2846-5352.notablePrerequisites: You control at least X Vampires.
1318-2846-5352.description:
Cast Doppelgang by paying {6}{G}{U}, targeting Dominating Vampire and a mana-producing permanent.
Holding priority, activate Echo Mage by paying {U}{U} and tapping it, copying Doppelgang, targeting Dominating Vampire and a mana-producing permanent.
Resolve the copy of Doppelgang, creating two copies of Dominating Vampire and the mana-producing permanent.
When the Dominating Vampire tokens enter, they trigger, untapping Echo Mage and any other applicable permanent.
Holding priority, activate the two mana-producing permanent tokens by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.
1318-2846-5352.notes: If desired, you may only resolve one trigger in step 4. This would allow the next iteration to target any other permanent instead of Dominating Vampire. You can then use the second trigger to untap Echo Mage again and proceed.

5299-5466-6472.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Deceptive Frostkite
5299-5466-6472.description:
Cast Deceptive Frostkite by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Deceptive Frostkite into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Deceptive Frostkite's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Deceptive Frostkite's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent.
Resolve Deceptive Frostkite's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 2.

454-509-1267-2003.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{B}{B}{R} available the first turn, with {4} each even-numbered extra turn
454-509-1267-2003.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
454-509-1267-2003.description:
Cause Medomai to become an artifact.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 5 one additional time.
Activate Contagion Engine by paying {4} and tapping it, putting two time counters on Idris.
Repeat from step 6.

1322-1563-2457-3000.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

997-3305-3817.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing Body Launderer to connive.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Body Launderer from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

2018-3213-4053.description:
Activate Boromir by sacrificing it.
When Boromir dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Boromir from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Boromir ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is a creature without summoning sickness

478-539-570--111.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three colors among permanents you control.
478-539-570--111.description:
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{W}.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Faeburrow Elder.
Repeat.

851-1912-2043-4715.description:
Activate Urza by paying {4}, creating two token copies of Prized Statue that are 1/1 Soldiers in addition to their other types.
When the Prized Statue tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.

2440-2905-4183-4720.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Pestermite
2440-2905-4183-4720.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Pestermite with haste.
When the token Pestermite enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Pestermite trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Pestermite, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Pestermite for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Stonework Packbeast twice by paying {4}, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

864-1987-3617-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
864-1987-3617-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Walk from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Walk during your draw step.
Repeat.

5256-6103-6105.description:
Cast Illusion of Choice by paying {U}, causing you to choose how players vote this turn and drawing a card.
Cast Magister of Worth by paying {4}{W}{B}.
When Magister of Worth enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Magister of Worth and any number of other creatures.
Resolve the Magister of Worth trigger, having each player vote for grace, returning all creatures from graveyards to the battlefield.
Resolve all abilities from step 4, milling one or more players.
Repeat from 3.

647-1409-2933-5798.easyPrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator paired with Drowner of Hope.
647-1409-2933-5798.description:
Activate Drowner of Hope by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Drowner of Hope trigger, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Drowner of Hope.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

719-2060-2567-2893-4482.notablePrerequisites:
Fertilid has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
"Plant" chosen with Xenograft.
719-2060-2567-2893-4482.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Avenger of Zendikar's second ability triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

1615-2034-3867-4231-5032.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Curious Pair, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Bösium Strip by paying {3} and tapping it, allowing you to cast instants and sorceries from the top of your graveyard this turn.
Cast Treats to Share from the top of your library by paying {G}.
Lucky Clover triggers, copying Treats to Share.
Resolve both Treats to Share, creating two Food, two Clue, and two Treasure tokens, and exiling Treats to Share.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {G}{G}.
Cast Curious Pair from exile by paying {1}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Curious Pair, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

2882-4918.notablePrerequisites:
Infinite Reflection attached to Lightning Runner.
You control at least three other nontoken creatures.
2882-4918.description:
Declare Lightning Runner and three other creatures as attackers, triggering each of their abilities.
Resolve the first Lightning Runner trigger, causing you to get {E}{E} and not pay for an additional combat phase.
Repeat step 2 two additional times.
Resolve the final Lightning Runner trigger, causing you to get {E}{E} and pay eight {E} to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2198-3358-4404.description:
During your upkeep, activate Hell's Caretaker by sacrificing Corridor Montior, returning Deceiver Exarch from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Deceiver Exarch enters the battlefield, untapping Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Hell's Caretaker by sacrificing Deceiver Exarch, returning Corridor Monitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Corridor Monitor enters the battlefield, untapping Hell's Caretaker.
Repeat.

678-1497.description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it, adding {R/G}.
Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Wild Cantor to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Wild Cantor by paying {R/G}.
Repeat.

776-1329-2709-4786.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Orcish Mechanics do not have summoning sickness.
776-1329-2709-4786.description:
Tap Orcish Mechanics, sacrificing Claws of Gix to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Claws of Gix.
Cast Claws of Gix.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.
